options.rationale: Correct: rules automatically act on incoming or outgoing messages, such as moving mail from a sender to a folder.

Signatures add text to outgoing messages.
Categories color-tag items but do not move them automatically.

items.stem: What is the difference between an appointment and a meeting in Outlook?

options.text: An appointment can invite attendees; a meeting cannot
A meeting invites other attendees; an appointment involves only you
options.rationale: Correct: a meeting includes invited attendees and responses, whereas an appointment is a block of your own time.
They differ in whether attendees are invited.
Both appointments and meetings can be recurring.

items.stem: Which TWO actions can you perform when managing a contact group? (Select TWO)

options.text: Add multiple members to send to all with one address
options.rationale: Correct: a contact group lets you address many recipients at once.

options.text: Remove a member from the group
options.rationale: Correct: members can be removed from a contact group.
Archiving is unrelated to contact groups.
